violation_type.title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))
violation_type.short_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing
violation_type.typical_finding: A merry go cycle was observed without loose fill beneath.    Note: A picture was taken.

finding_variants.text: A merry go cycle was observed without loose fill beneath.    Note: A picture was taken.
The outdoor play area did not contain loose fill and the play area had rocking equipment in the play area.
The operation has a step-2 Clubhouse Climber in the outside playground. The designated play surface has a height of 23 inches.  The operation has turf grass, under the equipment.
There is no surfacing under the play equipment with a containing slide.
During the monitoring inspection it was observed that there was no loose fill under the spring rockers in the playground area.
